mechanismOfAction.summary: Membrane-disrupting anticancer peptide; p53(12-26) MDM2-binding domain plus penetratin leader.
mechanismOfAction.description: Fuses the p53 residues 12-26 (HDM-2/MDM2-binding domain) to a penetratin membrane-leader sequence. Selectively forms transmembrane pores in cancer cells that present HDM-2 at the membrane, causing necrosis while sparing normal cells. No human data.
